headings.usage: Use for all page titles, matching modals, and profile names. Tracking tight (-0.02em).

body.usage: Use for bios, chat messages, and form labels. High readability.

labels.usage: Uppercase, tracking wide (0.1em), tiny text for overlines.

colors.notes: No pure white backgrounds for the main app body. Use #FDFBF7 (warm sand) for the background to make white cards pop. Use primary color (#E07A5F) for key CTAs (matches, swipes).

visual enhancers.surfaces: Neumorphism (The Tactile Variant) mixed with crisp borders. Flat solid surfaces with subtle 1px border (#E5E5E5) and soft ambient shadows.
visual enhancers.border_radius: Rounded-2xl (1rem) or 3xl for swipe cards and modals to feel friendly.
visual enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the background to make it feel organic.

grids.swipe_feed: Single column mobile-first, cards stacked absolutely with z-index for swipe effect.
grids.profile_gallery: Bento Grid: 1 large hero photo, 2 smaller square photos next to text prompts.
grids.chat_list: List layout with flex rows, dense but readable.

layouts.app_shell: Mobile-first width (max-w-md mx-auto) for desktop to mimic mobile app experience, typical of dating apps. Sticky bottom nav bar for main routes.
layouts.onboarding: Multi-step wizard. 1 question per screen. Massive progress bar at the top.
layouts.match_modal: Full screen overlay, blurry backdrop, celebratory large text and avatars.
layouts.alignment: Left align text in forms, center align text in match celebrations.

motion.swipe: Framer motion drag for Tinder-style cards (drag='x', useTransform for rotation and opacity).
motion.page_transition: Framer motion AnimatePresence for smooth sliding between onboarding steps.
motion.micro_interactions: Tap scale (whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}) for all buttons.
motion.liveness_check: Pulse animation on the border of the camera view to prompt user action.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on #E07A5F primary passes APCA. Use dark charcoal (#2B2D42) for all main text.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for swipe animations (fallback to buttons).
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY: Add data-testid to all interactive elements, e.g., data-testid='swipe-right-btn'.

media.photos: Avatars must use object-cover. Profile cards must have aspect-ratio mapping (3/4 or 4/5) to look like portraits.

3d libraries.usage: Not recommended for this app, keep it native and fast. Use Framer Motion for 2D card physics.

instructions_to_main_agent: Set up Tailwind config with the custom colors (Earthy & Soft Archetype). Background must be #FDFBF7.

Implement the Dating App layout pattern: max-w-md mx-auto relative container for the main app view (simulating a mobile screen on desktop) with a bottom navigation bar. Do NOT build a desktop sidebar layout.
For the Swipe/Match feed, implement Framer Motion drag functionality for cards.
For the Onboarding flow, create a multi-step component. Each step takes full height, 1 question at a time. Provide 3-5 screens.
For the Camera/Selfie step, use the standard HTML5 <video> API to capture a frame and simulate liveness with simple CSS pulses.
Customize Shadcn components (.js files): round the corners heavily (rounded-2xl) to make them friendly. Remove any default shadow.
Ensure 'data-testid' is added to every single actionable item (e.g., login buttons, swipe buttons, chat inputs).
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs and bottom sheets.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Warm & friendly design vibe: Focus on approachability.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
